beats.text:
Welcome to FEELZ.{pause:400}
Before your first session, a quick check-in.
Over the last 2 weeks, how often has the water seemed higher than it should be?

options.label: More than half the days
options.reply: Noted. You will notice what people hide. Calm will be harder to read.

options.label: Nearly every day
options.reply: Noted. You will notice what people hide. Calm will be harder to read.

beats.text: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you told someone you were fine?

options.label: Not at all
options.reply: Noted. Open books get better reception. The battery drains faster.

options.label: More than half the days
options.reply: Noted. Holding it in saves battery. Reception may vary.

options.label: Nearly every day
options.reply: Noted. 'Fine' saves battery. Reception may vary. You're practiced: small lies come easy.
